# RNForge Docs — LLM Context (Summary)

> This is the compact LLM context file for rnforge.dev. Use `/llms-full.txt` for the complete content.

## Site

- **URL:** https://rnforge.dev
- **Framework:** Docusaurus 3.10.1
- **Purpose:** RNForge provides native-layer wrapper packages for React Native. Forging the native layer for React Native.

## Package: @rnforge/react-native-in-app-updates

A capability-first, cross-platform React Native API for in-app update flows. Built with Nitro for type-safe native bridging.

- **Android:** Integrates with Google Play Core for immediate and flexible update flows.
- **iOS:** Reports Play-style flows as unsupported. Provides App Store lookup and store-page helpers.

### Docs Structure

- `/docs` — Main docs landing page.
- `/docs/packages/react-native-in-app-updates` — Package overview with support matrix and API surface.
- `/docs/packages/react-native-in-app-updates/install` — Installation and platform requirements.
- `/docs/packages/react-native-in-app-updates/quickstart` — Quickstart with code examples.
- `/docs/packages/react-native-in-app-updates/api` — API reference for all exports, types, and helpers.
- `/updates` — Release notes.
